description: Defines the OA_Admin_Menu_Section class representing menu sections in the Revive Adserver admin interface, including properties, constructor, accessors, mutators, and security checker creation logic.

classes.name: OA_Admin_Menu_Section
classes.description: Represents a menu section in the admin interface, with properties for section attributes, methods for managing subsections, access control, and security checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a menu section with id, name, link, permissions, and other attributes.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the section's identifier.

methods.name: setExclusive
methods.description: Sets whether the section is exclusive.

methods.name: setHelpLink
methods.description: Sets the help link URL.

methods.name: setNameKey
methods.description: Sets the translation key for the section name.

methods.name: setLink
methods.description: Sets the link URL.

methods.name: setSectionHasBeenReplaced
methods.description: Marks the section as having been replaced.

methods.name: hasSectionBeenReplaced
methods.description: Checks if the section has been marked as replaced.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the translated name of the section.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Returns the link URL with optional parameters replaced.

methods.name: setLinkParams
methods.description: Replaces placeholders in the link URL with provided parameters.

methods.name: getHelpLink
methods.description: Returns the help link URL.

methods.name: getRank
methods.description: Returns the section's rank value.

methods.name: isExclusive
methods.description: Checks if the section is exclusive.

methods.name: isAffixed
methods.description: Checks if the section is affixed.

methods.name: getGroupName
methods.description: Returns the group name for the section.

methods.name: setGroupName
methods.description: Sets the group name for the section.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the section type.

methods.name: setType
methods.description: Sets the section type.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a child section by id, optionally checking access.

methods.name: getSections
methods.description: Returns child sections, optionally filtered by access and type.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the parent section.

methods.name: getParentOrSelf
methods.description: Returns the parent or self if of a specific type.

methods.name: getSiblings
methods.description: Returns sibling sections, optionally filtered by type.

methods.name: setParent
methods.description: Sets the parent section.

methods.name: getChecker
methods.description: Returns the security checker.

methods.name: setChecker
methods.description: Sets the security checker.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs access check using the security checker.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a subsection.

methods.name: insertBefore
methods.description: Inserts a subsection before a specified existing section.

methods.name: insertAfter
methods.description: Inserts a subsection after a specified existing section.

methods.name: _getSectionIndex
methods.description: Finds index of a section by id.

methods.name: _addToHash
methods.description: Adds a section to the internal hash map.

methods.name: _createSecurityChecker
methods.description: Creates a security checker based on account-permission pairs.
